name: WordAI
author: softcoy

sections.description:
WordAI is an AI writing and image generation plugin for WordPress that helps site owners create posts, pages, titles, excerpts, tags, and AI images directly from wp-admin. It brings OpenAI, Google Gemini, and Anthropic Claude into one clean workflow so publishers, bloggers, marketers, and small business teams can draft content faster while staying inside WordPress.

Use WordAI to generate complete post or page drafts, suggest better titles from the Posts or Pages list, create excerpts and tags, generate AI images, and test a limited AI Agent knowledge-base workflow with frontend AI Chat preview. The free version is designed for real daily usage with sensible limits, while WordAI Pro unlocks advanced SEO generation, WooCommerce workflows, higher AI Agent limits, premium image controls, private updates, and support.

Learn more about WordAI Pro at https://softcoy.com/products/wordai-pro.

Features

AI writing workflow

  • OpenAI, Google Gemini, and Anthropic Claude provider support.
  • Provider-specific API Settings with model selection, including GPT-5.5.
  • AI content generation for posts and pages.
  • Title, content, excerpt, and tag generation controls.
  • One-click WordAI Title suggestions from Posts and Pages list screens.
  • Writing controls for language, style, tone, paragraph count, excerpt length, and tag count.

Image generation

  • Image Settings with GPT Image 1.5 as the default image model and ChatGPT Images 2.0 / GPT Image 2 as an optional model.
  • Standard AI image generation for free users.

AI Agent, support, and upgrade path

  • Limited AI Agent content embedding and frontend AI Chat preview.
  • Support page with diagnostics and SOFTCOY Support Office delivery.
  • Get Pro page for license-based upgrade to WordAI Pro.
  • Update-safe custom database table handling during normal wp-admin plugin updates.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New and search for WordAI.
  2. Click Install Now, then click Activate.
  3. You can also upload the plugin folder manually to /wp-content/plugins/wordai/ and activate it from Plugins.
  4. Go to WordAI > API Settings.
  5. Choose OpenAI, Google Gemini, or Anthropic Claude as your AI provider.
  6. Add the API key for your selected provider and save settings.
  7. Review WordAI > Content Settings and WordAI > Image Settings, then start generating content, titles, tags, excerpts, and images.
sections.faq:
What is WordAI?

WordAI is an AI content and image generation plugin for WordPress. It helps create post and page content, titles, excerpts, tags, AI images, and limited AI Chat responses from the WordPress admin.

Do I need an API key?

Yes. Add an API key for OpenAI, Google Gemini, or Anthropic Claude in WordAI > API Settings. The required key depends on the AI provider you select.

Which providers are supported in WordAI Free?

WordAI Free supports OpenAI, Google Gemini, and Anthropic Claude for content generation with provider-specific settings.

Which OpenAI models are available?

WordAI includes OpenAI model options such as GPT-5.5 for text generation and GPT Image 1.5 plus ChatGPT Images 2.0 / GPT Image 2 for image generation when available in your OpenAI account.

Why is GPT Image 1.5 the default image model?

GPT Image 1.5 is selected by default so most users can generate images immediately. Users who have access to newer image models can select them from WordAI > Image Settings.

Can I generate images in the free version?

Yes. WordAI Free supports standard AI image generation with free tier limits.

Can I use WordAI for WooCommerce products?

WooCommerce product content and image workflows are available in WordAI Pro.

What is AI Agent in the free version?

The free version includes limited AI Agent content embedding and frontend AI Chat preview features. WordAI Pro increases usage and unlocks the full workflow.

Does WordAI update database tables during normal plugin updates?

Yes. WordAI includes a versioned database updater that runs in wp-admin after plugin updates, so new or changed custom tables and columns can be applied without deactivating and reactivating the plugin.

Why are my results truncated?

This usually happens when API parameters are too strict. Reset to defaults in API Settings, then try again.

I do not see generated output. What should I check?

If your server blocks streaming, turn off Streaming in API Settings, save settings, and test again.

3.0.1

3.0.0

  • Major free release with refreshed WordPress.org readme sections and matching screenshot assets.
  • Improved WordAI admin branding with the current WordAI icon in row actions, modal titles, editor metabox buttons, settings headers, and API key notices.
  • Improved the WordAI API Key Required notice so it appears only on WordAI admin pages and explains the selected provider key requirement.
  • Set WordAI Free runtime communication to use live SOFTCOY endpoints by default for public installs.
  • Added Anthropic Claude provider support alongside OpenAI and Google Gemini.
  • Added GPT-5.5 text model option.
  • Added ChatGPT Images 2.0 / GPT Image 2 image model option while keeping GPT Image 1.5 as the default model for easier first image generation.
  • Added limited AI Agent indexing and frontend AI Chat preview features for free users.
  • Added Support page with local diagnostics and SOFTCOY Support Office delivery.
  • Added Get Pro upgrade flow for converting a licensed free install to WordAI Pro.
  • Improved provider settings, image settings, free tier-limit messaging, and modal output cleanup for newer AI model responses.
  • Added versioned database schema updater so new tables and columns are applied during normal wp-admin plugin updates.
  • Updated WordPress.org screenshot assets to full-page plugin admin views.

2.0.0

  • Major release with multi-provider support for OpenAI and Google Gemini.
  • Added unified provider selector across settings and modals.
  • Improved content and image settings experience.
  • Updated prompts, models, and defaults for higher quality output.
  • Highlighted WordAI Pro SEO Optimization features for upgrades.

1.0.0

  • Initial WordAI release.
  • Added AI post title, content, image, and title suggestion generation.
  • Added SEO-friendly content writing controls.
